two-calls.title: Two calls, one step
two-calls.caption: Time runs down the page. Both workers find the loan approved before either saves it, so both send money; only the bank's idempotency key refuses the second transfer. The spec calls find and save one step; the code makes them two.

labels.title: A label begins a step
labels.caption: Each cut line is a label. Everything between two cut lines runs as one step, so the other worker can act only at a cut line.

translation.title: What the translator writes
translation.caption: One action per label, named after it. The translator also writes pc, the end of the desk and the Termination property; where the labels go is still up to you.

interactions.title: One label per real interaction
interactions.caption: Draw a line from each call to its label. Two calls landing on one label hide a gap the spec can never show.

poll.title: Three branches, three awaits
poll.caption: Each branch of poll runs only when its await is true. For worker B, looking at a loan claimed by A, all three are false: no step is possible, so B waits.

flicker.title: Enabled again and again
flicker.caption: A's send flickers on and off with the line. Weak fairness promises nothing for a step that keeps switching off; strong fairness promises it happens, because it is enabled again and again.
